not_proven: No OS-level code execution is claimed for this root. A1111's custom-code script is gated behind --allow-code and is not used.
Windows forbids the quote characters in filenames, so this root is Linux/macOS only (and archives unpacked on Unix).

The demonstrated privileged effect is a same-origin POST the product accepted (HTTP 200), not a persistent state change. A longer payload would need a same-origin bootstrap (e.g. fetching its own model file back through /file=) which was not attempted.

The same filename ALSO lands in the unescaped search_terms span (modules/ui_extra_networks.py:312-320), so this artifact exercises two unescaped sinks at once; the canary does not distinguish which one fired.
payload_size_constraint: A path component is at most 255 bytes and may not contain '/', so the URL separators are built with String.fromCharCode(47). A full POST /sdapi/v1/options settings-rewrite payload measures 287 bytes and does NOT fit in a filename. That is a genuine limit of this carrier and is why the demonstrated privileged call is a body-less POST rather than a settings write.
